build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function with cutoff and knn parameters
build_chunked_radius_graph: build a chunked radius graph for one system using build_radius_graph_chunked to reduce peak memory during distance computation
compute_segment_argsort: compute the argsort within each segment using segment_argsort_vectorized for vectorized rank calculation across grouped tensor values
compute_soft_ranks: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment using compute_soft_ranks_single_segment with configurable k, delta, and sigmoid_scale parameters
run_batched_radius_graph: run the batched_radius_graph function to construct biknn radius graphs for multiple systems with optional chunked processing and pairwise distance computation
